title: Fiona needs ideas

read.intro: Fiona has written to her old friends' group chat. Read Joe's reply. What did Fiona write? Guess, then tap “Show Fiona's message”.
read.hidden: Help! Nadia has signed me up for a choir 😱 I haven't sung since school! What do you all do when you need to get out of the house? Any ideas?
read.reply: Ha, go Nadia! 😄 **When I need a break, I get out of the house** and walk by the river. **Can't explain it, but** it clears my head. And every Thursday I play football with some guys from work, **come rain or shine**. I'm terrible, but it **makes me feel part of something**. **At first, I** hated all the running, to be honest. **The problem was,** I couldn't breathe 😂 Now I love it. Go to the choir! What's the worst that can happen? What time is it?

task: Fiona has written to you too. Reply to her. React to her news, say what you do when you need to get out of the house, and maybe a class or a group that makes you feel part of something — what was hard at first and what the problem was. Encourage her and ask her a question at the end. A joke is welcome!

items: When I need a break, I get out of the house and …

map.h: Say what was hard at first

items: What's the worst that can happen?
What are you going to wear? 😄

plan_instr: Tap the phrases you'd like to use.
produce_instr: Write your reply to Fiona. (Prefer to talk? Tap Record it.)
model_title: Possible answer (yours can be different, of course!)
model: Fiona, this is brilliant! 😄 **When I need a break, I get out of the house** and go to the market. **Can't explain it, but** the noise and the smells make me happy. And every Tuesday I go to a salsa class, **come rain or shine** — **it makes me feel part of something**. **At first, I** was terrible: I kept stepping on people's feet! **The problem was,** I couldn't hear the beat 😂 Now I'm… not so terrible. Go to the choir! **What's the worst that can happen?** And **when did you last** see Nadia, by the way? Say hi from me!
